member.name: T:TrueAutomation.Workflow.TaskActions.NamespaceDoc
member.summary:
These are the namespace comments for TrueAutomation.Workflow.TaskActions.
This class contains the codes to perform various actions on the workflow activities. In order to avoid exposing the entire set of Task Service API calls to the workflow activity library (and thus the workflow designer), the set of calls to the task service have been moved here and are accessible using the classes within.
